name: Your Name
intro: Photographs made with the phone in my pocket: streets after rain, hills before sunrise, and the light in between.
about: I photograph with nothing but my phone. It is always with me, it is quiet, and nobody on the street treats it as a camera.
Most of these pictures were made on walks, on the way to somewhere else. I edit on the phone too, and keep it light: exposure, colour, a crop.
